verdict.rationale: Virtual-display creation on the host, so a session keeps rendering when the window is covered or the machine runs headless, is a fair question for a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack (pricing pages, homepage marketing, community threads, API probes) mentions virtual displays, headless rendering or display emulation.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
